description: Every number in the note's text, with the committed file and key it comes from. A JSON evidence item gives 'key' (keys and indexes) and 'fmt'; its value rendered with 'fmt' must equal 'expect'. A text evidence item gives 'match', a substring of the committed file. 'expect' must occur in the claim's 'text'. Formats: int, comma (thousands separator), len (length of a list or object), raw (str of the value), pct1/pct2 (value x 100, half-up), pct1z (as pct1 but 0 and 1 render as '0' and '100'), round1/round2/round3 (half-up). 'structural' lists phrases whose digits are references, not quantities. 'base_commit' is a commit on main at which every file in 'sources' resolves; the script does not read it. Checked by scripts/check_claims.py.
